title: Recording: Spirits Of Ancient Egypt by Wings | 1975
content:
Sea-Saint Recording Studio, New Orleans
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineers: Alan O’Duffy, Ken Laxton, Roberta Grace

Wings worked on the Venus And Mars song ‘Spirits Of Ancient Egypt’ on 21 January 1975.

The recording had Denny Laine on guide vocals and electric guitar, Paul McCartney on bass guitar, Linda McCartney on organ, and Geoff Britton on drums. Wings’ guitarist Jimmy McCullouch was yet to arrive in New Orleans.
